title: Upcoming emergency training exercise
summary: 10/09/2026 - On October 18 from 6 a.m. to 3 p.m., the Leander Fire and Police departments will be conducting a training exercise near Metro Drive and US 183 with CapMetro and neighboring cities.

title: Early voting begins Monday, Oct. 19
summary: 10/16/2026 - Early voting for the Nov. 3 General and Special Elections begins Monday, Oct. 19, and ends Friday, Oct. 30.

title: Leander discontinues funding Flock contract
summary: 09/04/2026 - The City of Leander will discontinue funding its contract with Flock, following the directive by the Leander City Council during its Sept. 3, 2026 meeting.

title: City Council approves agreement with CenTex Sports for major sports complex
summary: 09/21/2026 - CenTex Sports plans to invest $100 million for a state-of-the-art sports complex in Leander.
